        int t;
        unsigned long rev;
        ll cap, f;
    };

    vector<edge> adj[MAX_N];
    int dist[MAX_N];
    int ptr[MAX_N];

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        memset(dist, -1, sizeof dist);
        dist[s] = 0;
        queue<int> q({s});
        while (!q.empty() && dist[t] == -1) {
            int n = q.front();
            q.pop();

                    dist[e.t] = dist[n] + 1;
                    q.push(e.t);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != -1;
    }

                ll flow = aug(e.t, min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                if (flow != 0) {
                    e.f += flow;
                    adj[e.t][e.rev].f -= flow;
                    return flow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
